channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Austin Rivers | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Austin Rivers from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Michael Malone on Austin Rivers
item.description:
coach Michael Malone said.

“I just told our team, think about this -- guy was sitting at home for 2½ months waiting for his phone to ring. And it wasn't ringing. That to me is crazy to even think about. Austin Rivers is a good player. He's played in 45 playoff games prior to this season, and it just worked out for him and us that he's here.”

Michael Malone on Austin Rivers, May 28, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers, Ja Morant
item.description:
With Russell Westbrook resting, Austin Rivers will start for the Rockets.

“Someone is gonna have to chase Ja Morant around, and I’m gonna let Austin do it,”

Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers, Ja Morant, Jan 14, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Austin Rivers
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers coming off the bench when Chris Paul returns:

“It just gives us more depth and save some guys legs. Another good player.”

Mike D'Antoni on Chris Paul, Austin Rivers, Jan 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: James Harden on Austin Rivers, Kenneth Faried, Danuel House
item.description:
James Harden on persevering:

“A rough stretch. Chris goes out. We get Austin luckily. Clint goes out. We get Kenneth luckily. Lose D-House. As long as we can keep our head above water until these guys get back, ... we’re good. We know as a healthy unit, we can beat anybody.”

James Harden on Austin Rivers, Kenneth Faried, Danuel House, Jan 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Salman Ali:Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers:

“He's been a lifesaver.... He can play 30 or 40 minutes without being noticeably fatigued. He gives us another ball handler. He hits big shots. He's gritty.”

Mike D'Antoni on Austin Rivers, Jan 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Gerald Green on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Salman Ali:Gerald Green:

“Austin (Rivers) was great today. That's just another weapon we added to the team... We just got to keep getting better, keep finding little ways for us to improve. Adding Austin was huge for us.”

Gerald Green on Austin Rivers, Dec 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: Igor Kokoskov on Austin Rivers, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
Gina Mizell:#Suns coach Igor Kokoskov on what Kelly Oubre and Austin Rivers will bring:

“We need somebody who’s gonna help us with maintaining. A lot of games, we can’t go through the 48 minutes... We’re gonna find their roles. We definitely can use the talent and experience they have.”

Igor Kokoskov on Austin Rivers, Kelly Oubre, Dec 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Austin Rivers
item.description:
“When we have Austin out there, we gotta figure out ways that we can give him more opportunities. And like I said, that’s on me. I gotta do a better job.”

Scott Brooks on Austin Rivers, Nov 11, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Corrected tweet #Clippers Doc Rivers on facing his son, Austin, after coaching him for the past 4 years in LA:

“From a purely parenting father-son relationship, we've never been closer ... but now, you really want to beat him.”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, Oct 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Austin Rivers
item.description:
At the time, Beal viewed Rivers the way many opponents did and still do to this day.

“All of us, the AAU kids, we always hated Austin because we felt like he had an unfair advantage,”

Bradley Beal on Austin Rivers, Sep 28, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: John Wall on Austin Rivers
item.description:
John Wall on Austin Rivers:

“I think it's going to be fun and interesting. Austin is someone who I've always watched since high school. He's a competitive guy. He definitely can score the ball. High volume shooter, once he gets it going, he's going. I think it just gives us that guy that we've never really had off the bench, that can create for himself and can create for his teammates at the two-guard position.”

John Wall on Austin Rivers, Jul 14, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Ernie Grunfeld on Austin Rivers:

“One is the things that we really like about him, he plays with a chip on his shoulder.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Austin Rivers, Jul 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Austin Rivers
item.description:
“Acquiring Austin gives us another versatile, experienced player who provides scoring and playmaking,”

Ernie Grunfeld on Austin Rivers, Jun 26, 2018. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton, Austin Rivers
item.description:
Clippers coach Doc Rivers said.

“The guy that played the minutes before was Austin, he played those (40-minute games). We don’t want to do that. That’s probably why we didn’t play as hard, because guys were playing too many minutes. I think J.J.’s minutes have to go up a little bit, Jamal’s minutes will have to go up because we don’t want to tax Raymond and Austin to the point that they’re not doing what they do well. Raymond’s a great ball pressure guy. If you start playing him 38 minutes, his ball pressure goes down.”

Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton, Austin Rivers, Jan 18, 2017. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on Austin:

“He's young and clearly helped us, we all have to agree w/ that. I think he loved it here. He even liked the coach at times.”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, May 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Blake Griffin on Austin Rivers:

“I thought he was the guy that really changed the game for us.”

Blake Griffin on Austin Rivers, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Dan McCarney:Manu on Austin Rivers:

“He was an offensive punch we did not expect. He was a big key for them. He gave them a big, big boost.”

Manu Ginobili on Austin Rivers, Apr 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @danmccarneySAEN.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on coaching his son in his playoff debut:

“I've talked to DJ and Chris more than Austin. I don't know, maybe I'm being a bad dad.”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, Apr 19, 2015. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Kerry Eggers:Doc Rivers, on coaching son Austin with Clippers:

“It's not been that difficult, to be honest. He's just another guy who won't listen to me”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, Apr 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Austin Rivers
item.description:
“We're having conversations with Austin right now and trying to figure out what's best, but he could be in town shortly,”

Danny Ainge on Austin Rivers, Jan 13, 2015. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on Austin:

“I know there's been rumors and I can't talk about that but we're going to do what we need to do.”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, Jan 11, 2015. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Mitch Kupchak in statement on Ronnie Price suspension:

“We feel that the contact came from an attempt to block the shot and that there was no intent to hit Austin Rivers in the head, and therefore we are disappointed in the league’s decision.”

Mitch Kupchak on Austin Rivers, Nov 14, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Doc on coaching Austin:

“I'm not a big believer in parents coaching kids. I don't think it's a good thing.”

Doc Rivers on Austin Rivers, Jun 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Austin Rivers
item.description:
At the introductory press conference for Anthony Davis and Austin Rivers, the two newest members of the New Orleans Hornets, Davis took a playful jab at his new teammate, pointing out their level of success in the collegiate ranks.

“Unfortunately for Austin, I won a national title here [at the Final Four in New Orleans],”

Anthony Davis on Austin Rivers, Jun 30, 2012. Source: NBC Sports.
